title: No-JS/no-fetch users see item 6's save promise, but the saver and continue button need JS+fetch
evidence:
+- Given the /apply form, when rendered without JS, then the prep block lists exactly the user's 6 items verbatim and no prep-note paragraph follows.
+    // without them the form stays a plain one-visit submission — no saver,
+    // no continue button (the checklist promise is fulfilled only once the
+    // capability is real).
detail: Item 6 ('answers save as you go... email yourself a link') renders in SSR unconditionally, but the saver and continue button need JS+fetch (capability gate). No-JS users now see a save promise the form can't keep.
recommended_fix: Either gate item 6 behind the capability (restore a JS swap, or omit it from no-JS SSR), or reword it so it doesn't promise saving/email-link to clients that can't deliver.

title: Em-dash verification rg commands miss a literal em-dash in priv/static JS and shared/src
evidence:
+- `rg -n '\\u\{2014\}|—' server/src client/src server/priv/static shared/src --glob '*.{gleam,js}'` -- every hit is a comment/log, justified in PR
+- `rg -n '—' server/src client/src --glob '*.gleam' | sed 's/^[^:]*:[0-9]*://' | rg -v '^\s*//' | rg '"'` -- remaining hits are logs only
detail: The literal em-dash scan is scoped to server/src and client/src .gleam only; the other scan matches escaped/entity forms, not the literal character. So a literal em-dash in priv/static JS or shared/src gleam escapes both checks.
recommended_fix: Run a single scan for the literal em-dash across all four roots and both globs (server/src client/src server/priv/static shared/src --glob '*.{gleam,js}'), merging the escaped/entity patterns into it.
